description: Implementation of BatteryNotifier class managing battery-related events and service interactions in Android.

classes.name: BatteryNotifier
classes.description: Manages battery-related notifications and service interactions, including tracking video, audio, flashlight, and camera usage.

classes.name: BatteryNotifier::DeathNotifier
classes.description: Handles death notifications for the battery stats service.

methods.name: binderDied
methods.description: Called when the battery stats service dies; triggers cleanup.

methods.name: ~BatteryNotifier
methods.description: Destructor for BatteryNotifier; unlinks death notifier.

methods.name: noteStartVideo
methods.description: Increments video usage count for a UID and notifies battery service if starting first video.

methods.name: noteStopVideo
methods.description: Decrements video usage count for a UID and notifies battery service if stopping last video.

methods.name: noteResetVideo
methods.description: Resets all video usage counts and notifies battery service.

methods.name: noteStartAudio
methods.description: Increments audio usage count for a UID and notifies battery service if starting first audio.

methods.name: noteStopAudio
methods.description: Decrements audio usage count for a UID and notifies battery service if stopping last audio.

methods.name: noteResetAudio
methods.description: Resets all audio usage counts and notifies battery service.

methods.name: noteFlashlightOn
methods.description: Marks flashlight as on for a given ID and UID, notifies battery service if state changes.

methods.name: noteFlashlightOff
methods.description: Marks flashlight as off for a given ID and UID, notifies battery service if state changes.

methods.name: noteResetFlashlight
methods.description: Resets all flashlight states and notifies battery service.

methods.name: noteStartCamera
methods.description: Marks camera as started for a given ID and UID, notifies battery service if state changes.

methods.name: noteStopCamera
methods.description: Marks camera as stopped for a given ID and UID, notifies battery service if state changes.

methods.name: noteResetCamera
methods.description: Resets all camera states and notifies battery service.

methods.name: onBatteryStatServiceDied
methods.description: Handles cleanup when battery stats service dies.

methods.name: getBatteryService_l
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the battery stats service, linking death notifier and restoring state if available.
